description: This nested extras fixture bounds observation sharing with a close family (engine §4.1).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision
%rule text $c:candidate %conditions $c.without-elision-except(fam).matches(rival)
%rule candidate c B
%rule c X c [+T] | X [+T]
%rule rival r B
%rule r X r [+T] | X s [+T] | X r e [+T] | X [+T]
%rule s X r [+T] | X s [+T] | X [+T]
%rule e [+E]
%rule fam r | e
